name: Fennel Tea
siboNotes: Fennel tea may have antispasmodic properties that could help with digestive discomfort. Generally well-tolerated in SIBO protocols when consumed in normal amounts.
preparationTips: Use 1-2 teaspoons of fennel seeds per cup of boiling water
Steep for 5-10 minutes for optimal flavor without becoming too strong
Strain seeds before drinking to avoid consuming whole seeds
Can be enjoyed hot or cold throughout the day
nutritionalHighlights: Contains anethole, which may aid digestion
May help reduce bloating and gas
